Question: 已知某商品的需求量增加80%，而同期消费者的收入却增加了40%，则该商品很可能是____。
Options A 必需品 B 奢侈品 C 一般低档商品 D 吉芬商品.

Income elasticity of demand = % change in quantity demanded / % change in income = 80%/40% = 2. Positive >1 => luxury good (luxuries have income elasticity >1; necessities 0-1; inferior negative; Giffen is inferior with positive price effect, not income elasticity). So B.
